_comment: Information subsystem content: the fog dial's purchase rungs and gold prices, plus information-revealing parameters. Every number is ASSUMED for a plain fantasy setting (see docs/CONSTANTS.md); none reproduces a commercial title. The dial W in {0..K}, K=FOG_K=4: W=0 full fog and no purchases; W=K full observability; intermediate rungs enable purchase types and shrink prices (design §2). SCOUT is priced IN KIND (a unit's production + per-turn upkeep + exposure risk), charged through the existing production/upkeep ledger -- it adds no action and no gold price.

city_sight.note: sight radius contributed by every city to its owner's visible set

spy_tech.note: SPY purchases require this tech (design: 'tech-gated'; the tree has no espionage tech, so the gate reuses writing)

spy_duration.note: a spy reveals the target city's hex and production queue for k observation turns

trade_corridor_radius.note: TRADE reveals the hexes within this radius of the hex line between the two capitals, as a one-shot memory write

scout_pricing.value: in kind: unit production cost + per-turn upkeep + exposure risk
scout_pricing.note: SCOUT (design section 2) is a unit's sight: it adds no action and no gold price; it is charged through the existing production and upkeep ledger

rung_purchases.note: purchase types enabled per fog-dial rung; W=4 is already full observability so nothing is purchasable

prices.note: gold price per purchase type per dial rung; a rung absent from a type's table means the type is not purchasable at that rung

belief_particles.note: fixed particle count for the particle-filter belief on maps too large for exact enumeration

belief_support_cap.note: support-size accounting stops counting above this bound and reports the cap instead (used in purchase record entries)
